# What is Modern JavaScript?

#### Course: Modern JavaScript Essentials

## What is Modern JavaScript?

Modern JavaScript refers to the features introduced in ES6 and later versions:

- Better variable declarations - const and let instead of var
- Cleaner function syntax - Arrow functions (=>)
- Powerful array methods - map(), filter(), forEach(), some(), every()
- Object-oriented programming - ES6 classes
- Destructuring and spread - Extract and combine data elegantly
- Safety features - Optional chaining (?.) and nullish coalescing (??)

These aren't optional extras or fancy tricks. This is how professional JavaScript is written in 2026. If you read modern codebases, documentation, or tutorials, you'll see these patterns everywhere.
